sources.snippet: To address these limitations, this work presents a new paradigm for AI-generated image attribution by formulating it as an instance retrieval problem instead of a conventional image classification problem. We propose an efficient model-agnostic framework, called Low-bIt-plane-based Deepfake Attribution (LIDA).
